span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Confidence arises because evidence for each option accumulates stochastically during value comparison, so trial-to-trial noise makes the final gap between accumulators (and hence confidence, speed and accuracy) vary even at fixed initial value difference.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Inter-trial noise in the comparison process drives the joint pattern of confidence, reaction time and accuracy.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Confidence computed in vmPFC becomes reportable by being read out by a hierarchically distinct second-order network in rRLPFC.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Noise added at the read-out stage degrades the correspondence between reported confidence and actual accuracy, producing individual differences in metacognition.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: in the race model confidence is the gap between the two accumulators when one crosses threshold, so it tracks trial-to-trial noise rather than the starting value difference
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the same noise makes a trial faster, more accurate and more confident at once, which is why the three covary without any of them causing the others
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: because confidence follows the stochastic path rather than the initial difference, the model itself explains why value and confidence come apart
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a second-order region reads confidence out of the comparison process, and how faithfully it does so varies between people
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Only a small, experimentally controllable subset of the factors that could influence confidence was measured.
span.note: what this limits: the account of what drives confidence: WE REPORT A LIMITED SET OF THESE FACTORS ... FOR WHICH WE COULD EXERCISE GOOD EXPERIMENTAL CONTROL
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The design cannot adjudicate between confidence emerging in vmPFC and confidence being computed elsewhere and fed into vmPFC; that would need a high-temporal-resolution method such as MEG.
span.note: what this limits: the direction of the vmPFC-rRLPFC relationship: RESOLVING THIS POSSIBILITY IS BEYOND THE DESIGN OF THE CURRENT STUDY AND WILL REQUIRE OTHER TECHNIQUES WITH HIGH TEMPORAL RESOLUTION
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Alternative functional mappings from model confidence to reported confidence were not explored.
